Published zcash_address 0.13.0 (archive SHA256 5a854b28c07dba372f4410ea8ad62b4bf7d5c2bf8be32fc4b31bc0db6521a975) and zcash_protocol 0.10.5 (314329b91ec4bbb517441840e47d0b2029bf0b946f086980c96c889c2d92dc5d), MIT OR Apache-2.0.

Generated by privacy-network scripts/address-prefix/prepare.py at 23908ef. Three testnet HRP constants change; typed legacy aliases decode with their original HRP padding. Mainnet/regtest, transparent addresses and receiver bytes are unchanged. CI35938381018 passed baseline/patched suites and2304 fixtures for this version.

The desktop adapter preserves its existing0.10.5 lock version and applies patches at its own Cargo root; SDK dependency patches do not propagate. SDK23321888779d6ebcbccad6e34bd90a570a29e669 includes persisted-wallet compatibility fixes.

Local verification: locked Rust1.96 native build with workflow nu6.3 cfg; old released Windows wallet file opened by new Linux native adapter, matching canonical receiver identity, new address creation and save/reopen. This disposable-fixture check does not prove a live payment or owner-wallet recovery.

## SWARM production network type (2026-09-25, UNCOMPILED)

Four crates are vendored now, not two, because the SDK revision this addon is
pinned at — `d9f1a5b888067724b61b2fae46307ed56b4b1e0a` on the SDK branch
`codex/mainnet-sdk-identity-20260925` — admits `NetworkType::SwarmMain` and
`BranchId::SwarmMain`, and two further crates match those enums exhaustively.
Cargo ignores a dependency's own `[patch]` table, so `native/Cargo.toml` carries
its own `[patch.crates-io]` for all four.

| crate | version | archive SHA-256 | provenance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `zcash_address` | 0.13.0 | `5a854b28c07dba372f4410ea8ad62b4bf7d5c2bf8be32fc4b31bc0db6521a975` | vendored earlier; SWARM production arms added here |
| `zcash_protocol` | 0.10.5 | `314329b91ec4bbb517441840e47d0b2029bf0b946f086980c96c889c2d92dc5d` | vendored earlier; SWARM production arms added here |
| `zcash_primitives` | 0.30.1 | `403d5be1e96339534be098e3377fb8a78d68ca7585b1780133d884b810277418` | newly vendored, `https://static.crates.io/crates/zcash_primitives/zcash_primitives-0.30.1.crate` |
| `zcash_transparent` | 0.10.0 | `547c012778bae17f58007731af074d638aa146ab0ecfc120adebf23d049aff6c` | newly vendored, `https://static.crates.io/crates/zcash_transparent/zcash_transparent-0.10.0.crate` |

The two new archives were downloaded from crates.io (no local cargo registry
cache exists on this host) and their SHA-256 verified byte for byte against the
`checksum` lines `native/Cargo.lock` already carried for those exact versions,
before extraction. Those two `checksum` lines, and the matching `source` lines,
are the only lockfile deltas a path patch requires, and they were removed by
hand; the rest of `native/Cargo.lock` was not regenerated.

What was changed, and how it was derived:

- `zcash_protocol` and `zcash_address` took the SDK's diff **verbatim**. Every
  file the SDK touched was byte-identical between the SDK's vendored 0.10.4 /
  0.13.0 copies and this repository's 0.10.5 / 0.13.0 copies, so `git apply`
  took the patch with no fuzz. The one edit on top is in
  `zcash_address/Cargo.lock`, where the vendored `zcash_protocol` is recorded as
  `0.10.5` (this repository's version) rather than the SDK's `0.10.4`. That lock
  is only read when the crate is built on its own.
- `zcash_transparent` is pristine 0.10.0 plus the SDK's `src/zip48.rs`, which
  applies as-is because the SDK vendored the same version. `pub_prefix` now
  returns `Option<Prefix>` and answers `None` for `SwarmMain` rather than
  reusing Zcash's `xpub` or `tpub`.
- `zcash_primitives` is a **semantic port**, not a copy: this repository pins
  0.30.1 and the SDK vendored 0.30.0. The two upstream releases differ in
  `src/transaction/builder.rs`, `src/transaction/mod.rs` and four other files,
  so the SDK's copy could not be used. The SDK's five hunks were re-applied to
  the 0.30.1 text and the resulting delta was then diffed against the SDK's own
  delta: the two are character-for-character identical, so the port carries no
  extra change. The relevant 0.30.1 upstream difference is that
  `use zcash_protocol::consensus::BranchId::*;` moved from inside
  `valid_in_branch` to module scope, which does not affect the arms.

Standalone test runs of the two new crates need the same patch resolution the
addon build applies, so each carries a `.cargo/config.toml`. That is where the
patch lives here, rather than in a `[workspace]` + `[patch]` pair inside
`Cargo.toml` as the SDK worktree writes it: `native/` is a package and not a
workspace, the two crates vendored before this one carry no `[workspace]` table,
and declaring one inside a path-patched crate risks cargo refusing the addon
build outright with a workspace-membership error. The resolved dependency is the
same either way.

**Not compiled.** Nothing in this section has been built or tested in this
repository; the SWARM evidence quoted for these changes is the SDK worktree's,
against its own 0.30.0 copy. See `native/BUILD-NOTES-MAINNET.md` for what the
next agent must run.
